title: Condition for a horizontal tangent
text: A horizontal tangent occurs where $$\frac{dy}{dt}=0$$ and $$\frac{dx}{dt}$$ is not $$0$$.

title: Solve
text: $$\frac{dy}{dt}=2cos\left(t\right)=0$$ at $$t=\frac{\pi}{2}$$ and $$t=\frac{3\pi}{2}$$. At these values $$\frac{dx}{dt}=2cos\left(2t\right)=-2$$, which is not $$0$$.
